rootNamespace.description: Root namespace of the solution you're scaffolding into (e.g. MyErpApp, matching whatever -n you gave `dotnet new olympus-multi`). Defaults to ProjectNamePlaceholder, which is only correct if you're working directly in the un-renamed template repo -- override it for any real generated solution.

module.description: Name of the existing module (folder under Modules/) this feature belongs to.
